answer: The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, re-queued for a second panel. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the voyage of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The saffron holds work receipts rather than names, so the kernel of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
